descriptive_reference: For m Frobenius-normalized mutually orthogonal family members, rank-1 residual = 1 - 1/m. This is a descriptive reference, not a statistical null test.

raw_cross_layer_corresponding_weights.interpretation: No meaningful direct raw-coordinate shared rank-1 structure was observed across layers 0, 15, and 29 for WQ/WK/WV/WO/gate/up/down.

swiglu_descriptor_concentration.interpretation: Among the three audited layers, layer 15 has the strongest channel-descriptor concentration; layer 0 is close to uniform by this metric.

scientific_interpretation: A single shared raw basis across distant corresponding layers is not supported by this audit.
Local architecture-aware families, especially GQA Q/K groups, are a better root-search target than raw cross-layer weight sharing.
MLP channel concentration is strongly layer-dependent, so a uniform per-layer codec policy is unlikely to be optimal.
Value-output operator concentration partly reflects known GQA reuse and must not be counted as new compression gain without an exact bit ledger.
next_gate: Task-conditioned functional sensitivity on the strongest local candidates before any removability, codec-rate, or 64x claim.
forbidden_inference: no codec bit claim from span residual
no task-quality claim from energy or cosine
no 64x feasibility claim from raw structure alone
